claims.statement: The pinned statement says an Enterprise purchase includes access to both Cloud and Server. This is historical product scope, not a verified contract, actual purchase, unrestricted feature entitlement, current pricing or per-file redistribution rights; no procurement occurred.

Cloud identity options distinguish personal accounts with optional additional SAML restriction from IdP-provisioned managed accounts. Optional SAML belongs to the personal-account path, not a universal security recommendation or EMU exemption; no actual account model was selected or verified.

The fragment contains only the scalar 30. Its trial-length filename suggests intended use, but the text alone supplies no unit, start event, eligibility, expiry or billing behavior. No thirty-day trial or current entitlement is certified without containing-page context.

The fragment defines GHES as a self-hosted version of the GitHub platform. Self-hosting is not observed deployment, air-gapping, feature parity, complete control or regulatory compliance certification.

The fragment describes GHES on customer infrastructure with customer-defined firewalls, network policies, IAM, monitoring and VPNs, and makes a regulatory-use suitability claim. Suitability is upstream descriptive positioning, not legal compliance, validated controls, data-residency assurance or proof public-cloud risks are eliminated. No infrastructure or security control was inspected or changed.

In the GHES branch, sessions terminate after two weeks of continuous inactivity regardless of instance authentication method. Inactivity timeout is not absolute session lifetime, every-token revocation, immediate user deprovisioning or verified native behavior. No session or authentication setting changed.
